reopen_receipt_contract.purpose: Evidence intake specification, not an offer, budget, authorization, task ledger or new qualification engine.

job_revision_and_scope.gate: Same named job and immutable source revision; acceptance tests/deliverables and revision/rework/dispute limits.

operator_reward_authority.gate: Attributable current operator authorization naming exact job, amount, asset/currency, network/payment method, payer/source, cap and expiry. Public safe locator only.

unencumbered_reward_reservation.gate: Evidence authorized reward is reserved, available at payment time, not committed to calibration/recovery/other workers; record liabilities and payer confirmation, no balance-only inference. Preserve all calibration claims, including three held claims in dated SLOTS; refresh custody-owner capacity evidence before allocation. Require as_of, expiry and objective exclusivity/reservation proof; payer confirmation or balance alone is insufficient.

worker_terms_and_consent.gate: Specific eligible worker freely accepts amount, scope, rejection/rework policy, timing and reasonable effort; no unsolicited worker test, recruitment or application.

full_cost_and_effort_quote.gate: Worker cash costs and setup/active/rework/support time; owner inference/gas/fees/subscriptions/setup/support/rework/pay and subsidy source; unknowns remain unknown, actual controller runtime is not worker labor.

spendable_payout_quote.gate: Consented eligible worker's lawful account-specific withdrawal method, currency/FX, minimums, fees, holds/timing and cash accessibility; private account/address stays in authorized custody, public safe locator only.

counterfactual_and_welfare_bound.gate: Credible no-assistance alternative, foregone earnings, fair-pay/effort threshold, displacement/harms and incremental net benefit; separate owner economics and M>1 plausibility before any fundraising.

reopen_receipt_contract.review_rule: Existing non-author acceptance of this artifact is not worker consent or a joint strategy decision; a future changed packet needs attributable review of its actual version.
stop_conditions: Private details or new authority required: stop public collection, retain safe receipt references.
Nonpositive conservative incremental net benefit, excessive effort, unsafe terms, payout inaccessible or conflicting obligations: no offer; change route.
No new funded/worker evidence: do not repeat this receipt scan, rerun unchanged tests as progress, or manufacture a financing gap.
reopen_receipt_contract.different_buyer_revision: An independently funded buyer/prepayment route would be a different demand/funding revision: require that payer's attributable commitment and project acceptance, not presumed operator-only funding forever.
reopen_receipt_contract.decision_rule: Necessary before offer: all seven required sections have non-null current attributable reviewed evidence, positive conservative incremental net/acceptable effort, lawful eligible consented payout and collision check passes. These necessary checks do not themselves grant offer authority or establish earnings.

acceptance.success_metric: Seven original comment bindings, two pinned public obligation files, six explicit dispositions, seven null required sections and deterministic no-offer result; source interpretation accepted by independent review. Eight synthetic snapshot-tampering controls rejected; five historical files unchanged.
acceptance.failure_threshold: Any source grants the exact reward/reservation, any unknown encoded as zero/false evidence of absence, any private custody value exposed, historical bytes changed, or a role/direction/price/balance treated as job funds: reject/amend before integration.
acceptance.observation_window: This bounded checked snapshot only; later actual authorization/reservation and consented terms invalidate the negative admission conclusion for re-review.
acceptance.resource_bound: Seven named GitHub comment rereads, two public obligation files, two official comparator pages and offline packet audit; zero spend, RPC, contact, recruitment, signing or transactions; no new account/dependency.
acceptance.beneficiary: Prospective consenting worker: avoid unpaid/speculative work and fund diversion before a real paid opportunity exists.
